seasonNote: 166 results from the 2025-26 indoor season were scored on the 2026 season tables (the earliest authoritative tables).
notes: Each meet is projected using only results dated before it (no peeking). Points are the real engine's points under the current rules.
withEntries = the athlete's events at that meet were known in advance (as with published entries); withoutEntries = events had to be guessed from history.
naiveLastMeet = 'they'll score what they scored last meet' baseline, for comparison.
coverage = share of actual scores within the projected ± spread.
headToHead = for every pair of athletes at the same meet, how often the one projected higher actually scored more.
STRICT: marks on file (PBs) were ignored because they may be newer than the meet; only results dated before each meet were used.
withEntries is OPTIMISTIC: it uses the events each athlete actually contested as a stand-in for published entries.
pool = every athlete with earlier results projected without entries (as on the waiver wire); actual = 0 when they didn't compete.
